title: Gorn mode and independent camera-shake controls
summary: The host pause menu shows the Gorn crash mode and camera shake independently selectable, with camera shake Off in this captured state.
details: Host Chromium Metal capture at 1280×844 shows the saved crash-mode choice as Gorn (blood & limbs) and the separate Camera shake setting as Off. The severe crash capture is a separate checkpoint image; this settings image records the visible control state only.
limitation: Host-only settings evidence. It does not establish persistence on the public deployment or physical-device behavior; validated public release is pending.
caption: Host pause menu at 1280×844: Gorn crash effects selected and camera shake Off. Host capture; public release pending.
